subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below. 1  5 =
stimulus: Drug addiction is strong attraction for any harmful thing. It has not only a national but also a global problem. Drugs means used for intoxicating and stimulating effects. These drugs are grasped the young generation of the country. Addiction taken by smoking or through injection.
guide_solution: (a) Addiction means strong attraction for any harmful thing. (b) Drug addiction is not only a national but also a global problem. (c) Drug addiction has grasped the young generation of the country. (d) Drugs are used for intoxicating and stimulating effects. (e) These drugs are taken by smoking or through injection.
